segments.ja265:1.1: Disvā khurappe dhanuveganunne, khagge gahīte tikhiṇe teladhote;
segments.ja265:1.3: Tasmiṃ bhayasmiṃ maraṇe viyūḷhe, kasmā nu te nāhu chambhitattaṃ.
segments.ja265:2.1: Disvā khurappe dhanuveganunne, khagge gahīte tikhiṇe teladhote;
segments.ja265:2.3: Tasmiṃ bhayasmiṃ maraṇe viyūḷhe, vedaṃ alatthaṃ vipulaṃ uḷāraṃ.
segments.ja265:3.1: So vedajāto ajjhabhaviṃ amitte, pubbeva me jīvitamāsi cattaṃ;
segments.ja265:3.3: Na hi jīvite ālayaṃ kubbamāno, sūro kayirā sūrakiccaṃ kadācīti.

lines: Kasmā nu te nāhūti kena nu kho kāraṇena nāhosi.
Taṃ sutvā ārakkhakajeṭṭhako itarā dve gāthā abhāsi –
“Disvā khurappe dhanuveganunne, khagge gahīte tikhiṇe teladhote;
Tasmiṃ bhayasmiṃ maraṇe viyūḷhe, vedaṃ alatthaṃ vipulaṃ uḷāraṃ.
“So vedajāto ajjhabhaviṃ amitte, pubbeva me jīvitamāsi cattaṃ;
Na hi jīvite ālayaṃ kubbamāno, sūro kayirā sūrakiccaṃ kadācī”ti.
Pubbeva me jīvitamāsi cattanti mayā pubbeva tava hatthato bhatiṃ gaṇhanteneva jīvitaṃ cattamāsi.
Na hi jīvite ālayaṃ kubbamānoti jīvitasmiñhi nikantiṃ kurumāno purisakiccaṃ kadācipi na karoti.
